name: A-Kei Otaku Kanojo
source:
The “Media Art Club” that the protagonist joined was a gathering of otaku girls and only a cultural club in name. If you work with the girls to win the Club Presentation that will be held a week later, you may be able to win one of their hearts! A “honomoe love adventure” that tickles the male instinct appears on Switch.

[from [url=https://gematsu.com/2018/08/romance-visual-novel-a-kei-otaku-kanojo-coming-to-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
主角加入的「媒體藝術社」，名義上是文化類社團，實際上卻是一群宅女的聚會場所。如果與女孩們攜手，在一週後的社團展示會上奪得優勝，也許就能贏得其中一人的芳心！這款撩動男生心絃、帶著淡淡萌意的戀愛冒險遊戲，現已登上Switch。

[摘自[url=https://gematsu.com/2018/08/romance-visual-novel-a-kei-otaku-kanojo-coming-to-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
